description.content: Returns a single connector by ID. Requires connector_read permission.
Updates a single connector. Requires connector_update permission.
Deletes a single connector by id. Requires connector_delete permission.
Returns a single connector by ID with unmasked sensitive fields. Requires connector_get_sensitive_fields permission.
Sets the check result of the connector. Requires connector_put_check_result permission.

Returns connectors matching the filter and sorting criteria. If multiple filters are specified, results will only be returned that match all of the specified criteria. Requires project_list_connectors permission.

query.description: Override the field used for sorting the returned list. Optional.
Override the sort order used. Optional.
Filter the results for connectors with this connector type. Optional.
Filter the results for connectors with a name similar to this name. Optional.
Filter the results for connectors with this data plane ID. Optional.
Include connectors marked as temporary (for testing only) in the results. Optional.
The page to return starting from 1 up to total_pages.
The number of records per page. The max is 1000.
